title: Grusch named Sarbacher as the key to the program's architecture

tellings.quote: allow you to understand the architecture of the program. Who would it be? And he said it was Sarbacher.

plain: David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who in 2023 testified to Congress that the US secretly holds recovered craft, was asked whose work would let someone understand how that hidden program is built, and he answered: Robert Sarbacher, a scientist. Ammar Kandil, a guest who says he spoke with Grusch, relays this answer. If true, it would point to Sarbacher as a key figure in how the program was set up.
